name: peerly
description: Encrypted hybrid team collaboration — Durable Object chat with P2P files and video

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly tsc -b && VITE_APP_ID=peerly vite build && pnpm run guard:bundle && pnpm run guard:size && pnpm run guard:preview
scripts.test: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @peerly/core test && VITE_APP_ID=peerly vitest run --maxWorkers=4 && pnpm run test:preview
scripts.test:workers: pnpm run build:core && mkdir -p dist && vitest run -c vitest.workers.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly playwright test
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @peerly/core run test:coverage && VITE_APP_ID=peerly vitest run --coverage --maxWorkers=4
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly playwright test --ui
scripts.worker:check: wrangler types --check && wrangler types worker-configuration.preview.d.ts -c wrangler.preview.jsonc --env-interface PreviewEnv --check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env='' && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.test:e2e:do: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly playwright test -c playwright.do.config.ts
scripts.build:e2e: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly tsc -b && VITE_APP_ID=peerly vite build --outDir ${E2E_DIST:-dist-e2e} && node scripts/check-e2e-fixtures.mjs ${E2E_DIST:-dist-e2e}
scripts.build:preview: pnpm run build:core && VITE_APP_ID=peerly tsc -b && VITE_APP_ID=peerly VITE_CONTENT_BACKEND=durable-objects vite build --outDir dist-preview && node scripts/guard-bundle.mjs dist-preview && peerly-check-vite-bundle dist-preview/assets 700000
